Eden (CS): Sharing a compact "demo safety-net" runbook we trialed this week for accounts flagged as renewal-risk: prefill top-questions, enable very short streaming heartbeats, and a tenant warm pool. Aimed to reduce demo stalls and provide CS an easy rollback. Putting it here so Solutions/SRE can weigh in.

Luca (SRE): Nice. Couple of operational notes: keep prefill payloads idempotent, and cap concurrent prefill tasks per region to 10 to avoid host saturation. Also metricize prefill failures per tenant.

Tessa (Eng): Agree on caps. Also recommend a soft TTL hierarchy: tenant-cache (60s) -> region-shared-cache (3m) -> warm-pool (10m). That way personalized tenants still get benefit via warm-pool.

Noah (Solutions): Sample prefill API we used in the pilot: 
```
POST /v1/prefill/run
{
  "tenant": "acct-9001",
  "queries": ["help","invoice status","reset password","welcome flow","summarize convo"],
  "parallel": 3,
  "stream_heartbeat_tokens": 2
}
```
We found parallel 2-3 balances latency vs cost.

Eden (CS): Pilot results: demo success up from 72% -> 92% (n=25). CS liked heartbeat because it avoids the "it's thinking" freeze. Ava (Customer) had good feedback too.

Ava (Customer): Confirmed on our side — went smoother. One note: when we heavily customize prompts per user, prefill sometimes returns mismatched context. We fell back to streaming only and it was ok.

Luca (SRE): For customized prompts add a quick heuristic: if system_prompt_tokens > 200 or prompt_variables > 5 then mark as "high-personalization" and allocate warm-pool rather than relying on tenant-cache.

Tessa (Eng): We'll add that heuristic to the prefill orchestration and an endpoint to view personalization score. Also adding trace IDs to prefill jobs so CS can open trace from Console.

Noah (Solutions): Operational checklist for CS kickoff (short version):
- Flip "Demo Safety Net" toggle 2-4 minutes before session
- Ensure model_variant pinned (avoid auto-rolls)
- Confirm warm-pool allocation if tenant is high-personalization
- Watch prefill.hit_ratio tile (>65% desired)
- If hit_ratio < 40% after 2m -> switch to streaming-only and escalate to #customer-success-escalations
- Use 2-token streaming heartbeats in UI

Eden (CS): Can we get a tiny Console tile showing prefill.hit_ratio and a one-click action to "force warm-pool"? CS wants minimal clicks during demos.

Luca (SRE): Yes to metrics and the action. We'll gate force-warm-pool by permission (CS leads only). Also adding an alert: ops-bot will notify if prefill fails 4 times in 10 minutes for a tenant.

ops-bot: Alert pipeline linked: #eng-oncall -> #customer-success-escalations for prefill repeated failures.

Ava (Customer): Another gotcha: some customers have strict PII filters that change model behavior. We had to run prefill with sanitized placeholders to avoid leaking. Could we include a sanitized-mode flag?

Tessa (Eng): Good point. We'll add prefill.sanitized boolean. If true, we substitute placeholders for sensitive tokens and mark the prefill as "sanitized" in metrics.

Noah (Solutions): Suggested Console language for customers: "We perform a short warm prefill of common queries before demos to make responses snappier. If your org uses personalized prompts, we reserve a warm pool instead to maintain accuracy."

Eden (CS): Draft one-pager checklist (for CS modal):
- Toggle Demo Safety Net 2-4 min before demo
- Pin model_variant
- Check prefill.hit_ratio > 65%
- If personalization flagged -> ensure warm-pool enabled
- If hit_ratio < 40% -> fallback to streaming-only and ping #customer-success-escalations
- Post-demo: send 1-question pulse to customer (Was experience snappy? Y/N) and attach to the enablement ticket

Luca (SRE): I'll add metrics: prefill.jobs_started, prefill.jobs_failed, prefill.hit_count, prefill.miss_count (tags: tenant, region, sanitized). Also instrument prefill.job_latency.

Tessa (Eng): I'll implement rate-limits and the fallback cache logic, plus an admin API for force-warm-pool. Expect a PR this week.

Eden (CS): Great — once PR is live I'll update the onboarding playbook and add the modal checklist. We'll run the rollout with 5 more accounts and report back.

Ava (Customer): Thanks team, happy to be part of the pilot.

Noah (Solutions): One last ops note: capture a short post-demo log (auto-attach prefill traces + hit_ratio) into the enablement ticket to speed debugging.

Eden (CS): Agree. We'll add that to the templated enablement ticket. Thanks all!

ops-bot: Thread will auto-archive after 48h inactivity.
